text: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2025, referred Administrative Inquiry IA28.2 from Councillor Chris Moise, Ward 13, Toronto Centre, regarding Micro-Shelters and Answer IA28.2a from the General Manager, Toronto Shelter and Support Services to the Economic and Community Development Committee for consideration.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Deferred the item to the July 9, 2025, meeting to be considered along with the 2026 Shelter Infrastructure Plan from Toronto Shelter and Support Services.
